answer_1.quote: We trained a large language model (LLM) to perform two tasks: Next Utterance Prediction and Game State Tracking. ... the LLM must generate the next utterance, such that it is both interesting and a plausible next turn in the D&D game.
answer_1.outputs: Generated next utterances in D&D game dialogues

answer_4.quote: We recruited professional raters to perform a manual evaluation. ... The annotators asked to rate each output along the three dimensions, following the evaluation procedure used for the Meena LM ): • Does the response make sense? (yes/no) • Is the response specific? (yes/no) • How interesting is the response? (10 point scale)
answer_4.guideline: Raters evaluated responses based on sense (binary), specificity (binary), and interestingness (10-point scale).
